 UPSC Prelims 2020: UPSC releases e-admit cards for Civil Services prelims exam on Oct 4 
 These e-admit cards can be downloaded from UPSC’s official website www.upsc.gov.in. The candidates will require their registration number and date of birth to download these admit cards ETGovernment 
 Published On Sep 02, 2020 at 07:08 PM IST

 Bookmark 
 Comment 
 With the Union Public service commission (UPSC) set to kick start the examination process for civil services (preliminary ) exam 2020, the Central agency has released the guidelines for taking up the exams during the Covid-19 pandemic times while releasing e-admit cards for the students. These e-admit cards can be downloaded from UPSC’s official website www.upsc.gov.in. The UPSC prelims 2020 exams will be conducted on October 4. The exam was earlier scheduled to be held in May, but was postponed due to Covid-19 pandemic outbreak. About 7 lakh candidates are likely to appear for UPSC civil services prelims exam this year. According to the UPSC notification, the admit cards for IAS prelims 2020 can be downloaded online from upsc.gov.in. The candidates will require their registration number and date of birth to download the admit card. The admit card will contain the candidate’s roll number and examination venue details. How to Download UPSC IAS admit cards 2020 Visit the official website of UPSC- https://upsconline.nic.in or upsc.gov.in admit card 2020
 Select the Registration ID/ Roll Number
 Enter the Registration ID and date of birth along with the Captcha code
 UPSC IAS 2020 admit card will appear on the screen.
 Candidates are advised to download the UPSC IAS admit card 2020 for prelims exam and check the details mentioned on the upsc.gov.in admit card 2020. It is advised to bring discrepancies to the notice of the UPSC immediately if any. UPSC IAS Admit Card 2020 Details Mentioned Candidates will find the below-given details on the UPSC civil services admit card 2020 Name of the Candidate
 Roll Number
 Exam Centre Address
 IAS Exam Schedule
 Instructions for Candidates
 Exam Conducting Authority
 UPSC 2020 Exam Instructions UPSC has also provided some important instructions on UPSC prelims admit card 2020 for candidates who are appearing for Civil Services exam . Read the instructions carefully before downloading the UPSC admit card 2020 Candidates should reach the exam venue at least 20 minutes before the exam and as entry shall be closed 10 minutes before the scheduled time i.e. 09:20 AM for the Forenoon Session and 02:20 PM for the Afternoon Session.
 All candidates should bring the UPSC prelims admit card 2020 while appearing for the exam.
 Keep the UPSC admit card 2020 safe till the declaration of result.
 Camera, Phone, Calculator, Pager or any other electronic device is not permitted
 Inside the exam hall.
